entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

A baa bekotói ga ka de Wathináthie bie wa maritána da de deti thien bia be goe nang da sika da-ka-ke-wa gowe babong. Tataa-go damong ka sjoko dja rong, bee wa tataa abonana, matha damoeneka dja ko mahto bahoewadjako. Abathie go sabona, Adajaali bie rong kie, bie rong kie boeroewata na ma da de damoeneka loko de bie rong kie.
